citation.authors: Anyanwu EG, Onuchukwu CL, Ojukwu CP, Anyanwu CN

record.population: 34 adults in a Nigerian hospital with wounds that had not healed in over 4 weeks
record.design: Parallel-arm, described as quasi-experimental with randomisation, comparing standard wound care with ointments made from three purified triterpenes extracted from shea oil
record.finding: The triterpene ointments were associated with wound contraction and better wound scores. These are isolated compounds in an ointment, not shea butter as sold or used.
record.note: Abstract read; I did not open the full text for control details. Small, one centre. Isolated compounds, not the butter.
